description: This file defines the React component 'EnhancedJsonViewer' which renders a collapsible, interactive JSON viewer with functionalities like expand/collapse, copy to clipboard, and modal view for detailed inspection. It handles various JSON data types including arrays, objects, strings, numbers, booleans, and nulls, displaying each with appropriate UI components and interactions.

methods.name: EnhancedJsonViewer
methods.description: Main React component that renders a JSON data structure with collapsible sections, copy and modal functionalities, based on provided props.

methods.name: toggleExpanded
methods.description: Toggles the expansion state of a JSON item based on its key.

methods.name: openModal
methods.description: Opens a modal to display detailed content of a JSON item.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies the provided content into the system clipboard.

methods.name: processJsonData
methods.description: Processes the raw JSON data into a structured array of JsonItem objects for rendering.

methods.name: formatLabel
methods.description: Formats JSON keys into more human-readable labels.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders the visual representation of a JsonItem based on its type (string, number, boolean, array, object, null).
